title: Bright Family 1BR | Sleeps 4 | Near Nashville DT!
description:
Unwind in Style – Just 8 Minutes from Downtown Nashville.

Step into this stylish one-bedroom apartment, the perfect home base for your Nashville adventure. Explore the city’s music, culture, and attractions, then return to a cozy retreat designed for relaxing and spending quality time together.

The space
Thoughtfully curated amenities and a comfortable layout make this getaway ideal for families looking to unwind, connect, and create lasting memories.

★ LIVING ROOM ★ - Sleeps 2
It is ideal for relaxing and enjoying the company of friends and family while watching a good movie or a show. 
✔ Comfortable Sofas with Pillows 
✔ Flat-Screen TV 
✔ Coffee Table 
✔ Sleep Sofa (Sleeps 2)

★ KITCHEN ★ 
The kitchen area with numerous cooking appliances and spacious countertops. If you want to take a break from the restaurants, then this is the place for you. 
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove
✔ Oven 
✔ Refrigerator/Freezer 
✔ Dishwasher 
✔ Toaster 
✔ Blender
✔ Sink - Hot & Cold Water 
✔ Trays 
✔ Glasses 
✔ Silverware 
✔ Pots & Pans

★ BEDROOM ★ - 
The bedroom features a comfortable bed designed to provide you with the perfect resting experience. 
✔  Queen–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2) 
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

★ HALLWAY ★ - 
✔ (2) Twin–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2) 

★ BATHROOM ★ 
The apartment features a spacious full bathroom stocked with all necessities and essential toiletries, so you don’t need to bring your own. 
✔ Mirrors 
✔ Toilet 
✔ Towels 
✔ Essential Toiletries

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with: 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning 
✔ Heating 
✔ Ceiling Fan 
✔ Washer/Dryer (in the unit)
